correctness.rationale: The spectral projectors for 0, N-p, and N yield exact entries; rational identities show all off-diagonals positive. The filter reaches minimum eta=(5-3sqrt(3))/2, yielding positive diagonals for N<=11. At h=8/(N-p), exact simplification gives a negative diagonal for every part when N>=12 because 45t²-66t+53>0 for all real t. The large-h rank-one limit proves positivity recovery. Exact standard-library replay checked 196 matrices/witnesses, 16,580 entries, 1,510 rows and 741 integer-pair witnesses, but the universal conclusion rests on algebraic proof.

value.rationale: It determines the natural sharp graph order for uniform unconditional endpoint positivity on the entire complete multipartite family; every graph at larger order has an explicit failure and every order below is safe.
